description:
You are a logistics coordinator auditing a shipping manifest. You need to determine the correct Department of Transportation (DOT) Packing Group for four flammable liquids based on their physical properties.

Use the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to look up the Boiling Point (BP) and Flash Point (FP) for the following chemicals:
1. Propylene Oxide (CAS 75-56-9)
2. Toluene (CAS 108-88-3)
3. Cyclohexanone (CAS 108-94-1)
4. Acetonitrile (CAS 75-05-8)

Apply the following classification rules (derived from 49 CFR 173.121) to determine the Packing Group:
- Packing Group I (High Danger): Boiling Point <= 35°C (95°F)
- Packing Group II (Medium Danger): Boiling Point > 35°C AND Flash Point < 23°C (73°F)
- Packing Group III (Low Danger): Boiling Point > 35°C AND Flash Point >= 23°C

Note: If a range is provided, use the lowest value for safety. Use Celsius values.

Create a CSV report file at '/home/ga/Documents/packing_group_audit.csv' with the header 'Chemical,Boiling_Point_C,Flash_Point_C,Packing_Group' and a row for each chemical containing your findings.
